readout_other: multi-electrode array extracellular spike and burst recording
direction_notes: Firing rate increased during ultrasound-on, followed by a reduction or pause in firing, then return to baseline; the response differed between wells.
safety_notes: Thermocouple measurement in a water-filled well gave a maximum temperature increase of 0.8 degC over 60 s.

exposures.label: 5 MHz continuous wave, 15 s and 60 s exposures

timing.protocol_description: Continuous ultrasound at 5 MHz for 15 s or 60 s; each treatment repeated three times with a 5 minute observation period (post period) between treatments; the experiment was performed twice for each protocol.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Preceding the exposure to ultrasound, activity of the neuronal culture was recorded for 5 minutes as a baseline measurement in seven MEA wells.
